titre: The 2008 crash, foreclosures and the power of lobbyists
resume: In 2008 the financial crash plunged the world into recession: 8.7 million US jobs were lost over two years and there were 10 million home foreclosures, while many of the very wealthy saw their net worths increase. Critics also cited the power of lobbyists and campaign donations as weakening democracy and hurting the people.
